sourceDocuments: Batch 1 and Batch 2 Acceptance Summary (canonical-task-map, paste)

tasks.title: Country terminology and cross-country browsing
tasks.expectedResult: With Customer Country different from Product Country, browsing/purchase across the boundary keeps Customer Country as the profile value and Product Country as the product Channel value; wallet is in the customer currency; price is in the Product Country currency; any conversion is recorded; order and receipt show the correct country and currency.

tasks.title: New-country propagation and full regression
tasks.expectedResult: A newly created/enabled country Channel appears in all four selectors (Product Country/Channel, Customer Country in profile, shipping-address country, target sales country on the design-publication page), and regression of every affected function (publication, visibility, price/currency, wallet/rates, tax, shipping, inventory, warehouse, cart, checkout, payment, orders, receipts, account views, cross-channel orders) passes.

tasks.title: Currency and numeric-price alignment
tasks.expectedResult: For at least two countries with different currencies, no view (index, detail, cart, checkout, payment result, order, receipt, wallet, account) shows one country's currency label with another country's number; the amount is either correctly converted or the configured country-specific amount.

tasks.title: Product visibility and variant isolation
tasks.expectedResult: Parent-design and image inheritance work; a variant is neither visible nor purchasable in a Channel where it is not available; price, stock, shipping, tax and warehouse come only from the variant's own country; any leak is reported.

tasks.title: Cart and checkout country locking
tasks.expectedResult: After changing browsing context and returning to checkout, the cart does not mix Product Countries: it either keeps the valid context or rejects the action clearly; product Channel, cart Channel, address country, payment currency, order Channel, tax context and receipt do not diverge.

tasks.title: Payment callback and order-state consistency
tasks.expectedResult: Payment result, callback, backend payment state, order state, receipt and ledger agree; a browser success without matching backend/order state is not PASS.

tasks.title: Clean environment, rollback and restart behavior
tasks.expectedResult: Clean initialization, migration, rollback and restart work on the isolated clone; environment identity and the reset/cleanup result are recorded.

tasks.title: Customer country selection and wallet currency
tasks.expectedResult: New-customer country choice (where applicable) and the profile selector list exactly the countries opened in the backend plus the permitted 'other country' option; the selected Customer Country sets wallet currency and default withdrawal currency.
tasks.gapNotes: No Spec task ID given; mapped from specRefs [4.3]. gap flag set.

tasks.title: Platform design publication
tasks.expectedResult: Overall effect image shows on the index; individual effect images show in the detail slideshow and the overall image is not one of them; selecting an effect image selects the correct design; name, SKU/design identity, country, price, currency and image associations are correct; the product completes purchase and order flow.

tasks.title: Customer design publication form and pairing
tasks.expectedResult: Customer publication form accepts design name, overall image, paired design/effect uploads, design fee and target countries; each design image stays paired one-to-one with its effect image; differing upload names are normalized deterministically.

tasks.title: Multiple-country publication and virtual inventory
tasks.expectedResult: One design published to several countries with different price, currency and virtual inventory: each country shows its own values; no cross-country inventory use; a purchase decrements the correct virtual stock; at zero the product is unavailable; the order keeps country and design identity.

tasks.title: Image synchronization and local archive
tasks.expectedResult: Design and effect images exist in the local archive with a unique SKU/design directory, the overall image identified as `0`, matching design/effect identifiers, and required JSON/log metadata; the export can locate the design file from the selected effect ID. Verified on disk, not by HTTP 200.

tasks.title: Standard product flow
tasks.expectedResult: A standard product (e.g. jelly glue) follows the single-price path with ordinary stock, order, receipt and platform revenue, and creates no design-fee or designer-commission record.

tasks.title: Custom press-on-nail purchase
tasks.expectedResult: A custom purchase lets the customer pick effect image, nail shape and finger; the order preserves design, physical product, shape, finger, size/model, Product Country, price, currency, tax, shipping and payment values.

tasks.title: Wallet and payment currency conversion
tasks.expectedResult: Where wallet currency differs from payment currency the evidence shows original amount/currency, payment amount/currency, rate, converted amount, debit order AUA→SNA→MCA, final payment state, resulting balances and ledger record; cross-currency wallet transfers (where present) and country-to-currency and country-to-rate mappings are visible.

tasks.title: Platform and designer financial split
tasks.expectedResult: For every configured split tier: tax handled before split; craft fee and design fee separated; platform and designer amounts correct; destination wallet (AUA/SNA/MCA) stated with reason; conversion recorded; order, receipt, platform record, designer record and wallet reconcile.

tasks.title: Order display and cross-channel index
tasks.expectedResult: A paid order appears in the buyer view, designer sales view and cross-channel index (order number, Product Country, status, buyer, designer, total); detail opens in the correct Channel; unpaid anonymous abandoned carts are excluded.

tasks.title: Order merging
tasks.expectedResult: Only paid, not-yet-exported, same-country orders merge; different-country merge is rejected; a permitted merge recalculates weight, shipping company, shipping price, tax, total and payment difference; an exported order is no longer mergeable.

tasks.title: Customer nail-size page and automatic matching
tasks.expectedResult: `/account/nail-sizes` saves multiple profiles; reference data is loaded; a custom purchase auto-matches the saved finger size to the reference table and writes the correct shape and model/size to the order and to the exported order.

tasks.title: Inventory and replenishment
tasks.expectedResult: Ordinary, physical blank-nail and virtual stock are handled separately; shared physical stock is consumed by both design types; zero of either makes the custom product unavailable; global and local warehouses hold stock by country/shape/model; a local order uses local stock; another country's warehouse is not exposed; low-stock warning fires for physical stock only; replenishment moves global to local with an auditable result.

tasks.title: Shipping and weight
tasks.expectedResult: Per-country simulated carriers and weight bands price shipping correctly by country, weight and carrier; merges and weight changes trigger recalculation and any extra payment; order, shipping record, receipt and inventory operation agree.

tasks.title: Tax and country
tasks.expectedResult: Per-country Tax Zone and rate mapping (and dynamic update where enabled) stays consistent through product display, checkout, payment, order, receipt and post-tax split; the actual rates used are recorded from the run configuration.

tasks.title: Account, delisting and administrative operations
tasks.expectedResult: Designer sales details are correct; customer self-delisting and authorized admin delisting work; related design files are removed or archived; the customer receipt shows correct price and tax.

tasks.title: Platform scripts
tasks.expectedResult: Each platform script is exercised or classified not-applicable with a reason; for each: command/invocation, input, revision, exit/error result, state change, generated files, cleanup.

tasks.title: Public demo: catalog migration adapter
tasks.expectedResult: bash evaluation-demo/scripts/verify.sh --acceptance returns PASS; evidence is the verifier output directory.
tasks.gapNotes: Extra task not counted in the 24 client-batch tasks.
